function.name: calculate_big_five_traits
function.description: Calculate the big five personality traits based on a set of questions answered by the user. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

answers.description: Answers to a set of questions rated on a scale from 1 to 5.

calculate_percentile.description: If true, the percentile rank for each trait will also be calculated.

average_answers.description: If true, answers will be averaged across each trait's questions.

message.content:
好的！為了幫你了解自己的個性，我們可以先做一個簡短的「大五人格」測驗。  
請你根據以下每個陳述，評估自己在最近一段時間內的感受或行為，並以 **1 到 5** 的分數回答（1 = 完全不同意，5 = 完全同意）：

| 編號 | 陳述 |
|------|------|
| 1 | 我喜歡與人交往，常常主動與他人聊天。 |
| 2 | 我在陌生環境中能快速適應，並不會感到過度緊張。 |
| 3 | 我經常關注細節，對於工作或學習中的小錯誤很敏感。 |
| 4 | 我喜歡嘗試新事物，對未知的挑戰感到興奮。 |
| 5 | 我在壓力下能保持冷靜，並能有效解決問題。 |
| 6 | 我喜歡有計畫地安排日程，並盡量遵守時間表。 |
| 7 | 我容易被情緒左右，對別人的情緒反應敏感。 |
| 8 | 我喜歡獨處，並在安靜的環境中思考。 |
| 9 | 我對未來充滿希望，並願意為目標努力。 |
|10 | 我善於表達自己的想法，並能說服他人。 |

> **提示**：如果你覺得某些陳述不太符合你，請直接給出你最真實的感受。

請把你的答案以數字陣列的形式回覆，例如 `[4, 3, 5, ...]`。  
如果你想知道每個人格特質的百分位排名，也請告訴我，我會在計算時加入這個選項。祝你玩得開心！
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "我是什麼類型的個性？" They want to know their personality type. We can ask them to answer some questions or use the function to calculate big five traits. We need to call the function with answers. But we don't have answers yet. We could ask them to provide answers to a set of questions. The function expects an array of numbers (answers). We can ask them to rate from 1 to 5. So we should respond asking them to answer a set of questions. Then we can call the function after they provide answers. But we can't call until we get answers. So we should ask them to provide answers. Also we can mention that we can calculate percentile if they want. So we ask them to answer.
